Hi Olivia / Samir —

Nice to meet you both (virtually). As discussed on our call, I put together a compact success-plan framework and a pilot acceptance matrix to make the POC timeline more concrete. The doc is a first-draft — it includes:
- Proposed milestones and owner assignments
- Success criteria for each milestone (functional + ops)
- Recommended gating for roll-to-prod

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1FyQ-sample-success-plan (editable for us)
Attachments: success-plan-framework-v0.1.gdoc (outline), pilot-acceptance-matrix.xlsx (matrix)

Request: can you review the acceptance criteria section and tell us whether the proposed gates map to OliveTech's evaluation priorities? If you prefer, mark comments directly in the doc.

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Week 0: kickoff + environment access
- Week 1–2: integration & data ingest
- Week 3–4: accuracy/latency checks, sample queries
- Week 5–6: pilot acceptance run + stakeholder review

If OliveTech is comfortable, we can compress to a 6-week window. If you need a longer runway, we can extend.

Next steps: I’ll schedule a 30m technical deep-dive with our solutions engineer (Marissa) — preferred times in the doc.

Thanks — looking forward to your feedback.

Best,

Thanks, Kimberly — appreciate the clear starter doc. A few quick items from our side: 
1) Data residency / retention: can you confirm default retention windows for logs and whether we can enforce a 30-day KV cache retention? We have a short internal policy we need to match.
2) SSO / provisioning: we'll need SSO (SAML) for our pilot users. Is that on the roadmap for the pilot or do we treat it as a post-pilot item?
3) Stakeholders: Samir (cc’d) will own technical sign-off; I’ll own business acceptance. Our preferred pilot window is slightly compressed — we’d like to hit acceptance at the end of week 5 rather than week 6 if possible.

I’ll take a pass at the acceptance matrix and leave comments in the doc later today. Also attaching a short availability spreadsheet for the next 3 weeks.

Hi team — looping in Rishi so he can see the proposed timeline and approve resource allocation.

Olivia — we can support SAML SSO for pilot scoped users; it will add ~3 business days to the integration sprint if OliveTech wants it turned on during pilot. Data retention: default logs + KV cache retention is 90 days in our hosted product but we can enforce a 30-day policy for a dedicated pilot environment — will confirm with infra.

Proposed compressed timeline to hit week-5 acceptance (if OliveTech agrees):
- Day 0 (kickoff): environment, credentials, SSO request form submitted
- Days 1–7: ingestion and baseline latency/throughput checks
- Days 8–21: functional test set + quality tuning (daily sync)
- Days 22–28: acceptance run prep + security checklist
- Days 29–35: pilot acceptance run + stakeholder review

I’ve attached an acceptance matrix we prefer to use for pilots (pilot-acceptance-matrix.xlsx). If you want us to compress further we can, but we'd need approvals for a weekend push.

Rishi — any concerns on committing a Solutions Engineer for Weeks 2–4?

Thanks,

Quick update and consolidation after Aditya's note and Olivia’s comments:

Confirmed items:
- SAML SSO: available during pilot; add 3 business days to integration sprint (OliveTech to provide IdP metadata).
- Data retention: we will stand up a dedicated pilot environment with 30-day KV/cache retention; logs will be rotated per OliveTech policy.

Updated (actionable) milestones for the MAP document:
- Week 0 (Sep 21): Kickoff + environment access + IdP metadata due
- Week 1 (Sep 22–28): Data ingest + baseline latency/throughput tests (owner: Marissa)
- Week 2–3 (Sep 29–Oct 12): Functional test set & tuning (owner: Solutions Eng)
- Week 4 (Oct 13–Oct 19): Acceptance run prep; security checklist completion (owner: Aditya + OliveTech Sec)
- Week 5 (Oct 20–Oct 26): Acceptance run + Executive review (business & tech acceptance)

Acceptance criteria (high level):
- Functional: end-to-end query correctness for the 50-sample test set >= 92%
- Performance: 95th perc. latency under 350ms for standard queries at target QPS
- Reliability: zero critical errors during 48-hour acceptance run
- Ops: SSO and user provisioning validated, logs accessible to OliveTech per policy

Next actions (owners):
- Marissa: schedule technical deep-dive (30–45m) this week; add agenda to the GDoc
- Aditya: confirm Solutions Eng availability for Weeks 2–4
- Kimberly: share updated MAP doc link and request comments by EOD Tuesday; loop legal on pilot agreement template for a limited-term data handling appendix

Updated doc link (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1FyQ-sample-success-plan
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/67890/DEAL-2026-0091

I’ll update the GDoc with the milestone dates above — please add any objections inline. If OliveTech accepts week-5, I’ll lock the pilot calendar and send calendar invites.
